name: Arimura Mayu
source:
Arimura Tadao's young daughter. After her parents divorce she stays with her father in the Family Planning Apartments. Secretly she's in love with her father. When she overhears the robot explain that it's purpose is to make sure couples become pregnant she seizes the opportunity to become her father's lover.

She proposes to her father that she pretend to be his new bride . . .
